goals: Assess the performance and reliability of the user profile, group management, and split transaction API endpoints under simulated user load.
activities: Register three new users with random usernames and default passwords.
Extract and store the authentication token and user ID from the last registered user.
Create a new group with a specified name and members, using the authentication token.
Extract and store the group ID from the newly created group.
Randomly select one of four possible API actions to perform.
If action 1 is selected: Retrieve the user's profile using the authentication token.
If action 2 is selected: Retrieve all available groups using the authentication token.
If action 3 is selected: Retrieve a specific group by its ID using the authentication token.
If action 4 is selected: Create a new split transaction for a specific group, amount, lander, and payers, using the authentication token.
